study_note: Prior-only TD-AMBI reward/Q-scale family. The persistent outer actor uses literal TD-MPC2 scaled entropy with fixed coefficient 1e-4, Q-only percentile normalization, and mean-pair Q; the distributional critic uses reward-only min-pair targets with coefficient 0.1. Collection samples the stochastic outer policy after the standard random warmup, with mpc=false and inner_operator=none. Inner compute counts are zero and inactive inner-only settings are neutralized; these neutral values do not change outer learning. All step checkpoints and adjacent metadata are retained every 25,000 decisions, including learned outer Q-scale state. All variants retain Humanoid Walk state observations, seed 55, 2 million decisions, outer batch 256, UTD=1, H=3, rho=0.5, model-size 5, and the other TD-AMBI backbone settings. Controller evaluation, paired controller evaluation, real-environment value evaluation, value-equivalence diagnostics/loss, and imagined diagnostics are disabled. This is a single-seed exploratory comparison, not confirmatory evidence. Each completed run produces 80 scheduled checkpoints.
